description: Language-neutral source of truth for shared EventCast livestream contracts: SRS callback payload shapes, internal API error codes, and the fixed lifecycle state enums. Go and TypeScript representations in this package must match this file exactly; this file must match the committed 0019_livestream_control_plane.sql migration CHECK constraints and the committed Media Agent SRS callback handler.

srsCallbacks.description: SRS posts the same JSON envelope shape to on_publish, on_hls, and on_unpublish, with the fields relevant to each action populated and the rest zero-valued (03_DATA_MODEL_AND_API_CONTRACTS.md 'SRS callback contracts'; services/media-agent/internal/srs/srs.go Payload).

envelopeFields.name: action
envelopeFields.description: SRS callback action name, e.g. on_publish, on_hls, on_unpublish.

envelopeFields.name: ip
envelopeFields.description: Publisher/client source IP as seen by SRS.

envelopeFields.name: stream
envelopeFields.description: Stream name; carries the non-secret ingest identifier (03_DATA_MODEL_AND_API_CONTRACTS.md on-publish).

envelopeFields.name: param
envelopeFields.description: RTMP publish query string; may carry a secret stream token. Never logged.

envelopeFields.name: file
envelopeFields.description: Absolute path of the completed HLS segment or manifest file under the SRS staging root (on_hls).

envelopeFields.name: url
envelopeFields.description: SRS-reported URL of the completed file (on_hls).

envelopeFields.name: m3u8
envelopeFields.description: Path of the local SRS m3u8 playlist associated with the segment (on_hls).

on_publish.notes: The Media Agent extracts the non-secret ingest identifier from stream and the secret token from param, validates both, and creates a session. Success returns HTTP 200 with {"code":0}. Rejection returns HTTP 200 with a non-zero code or another SRS-compatible rejection response. MUST NOT perform R2 or Wasabi operations.

on_hls.notes: Validates the active session, resolves the file under the SRS staging root, hard-links (or atomically copies) it into the protected Media Agent spool, fsyncs, writes an idempotent segment job, and returns success. A callback success means durably captured and queued, not already present in R2.

on_unpublish.notes: Closes the current session, records the disconnect reason when known, and emits an outbox status update. Does not delete files, close the event, or publish ENDLIST.

successResponse.description: SRS-compatible success body every accepted callback returns.

fields.name: code
fields.description: 0 on success. A non-zero code tells SRS to reject the action.

errorCodes.description: Stable machine-readable error codes for internal APIs and Media Agent jobs (03_DATA_MODEL_AND_API_CONTRACTS.md 'Error model'). Must match the media_jobs.last_error_code CHECK constraint in 0019_livestream_control_plane.sql exactly.

mediaNodeStates.description: media_nodes.status lifecycle (03_DATA_MODEL_AND_API_CONTRACTS.md 'media_nodes'; ADR-014). Only healthy nodes outside maintenance_mode may receive new assignments.

eventMediaStates.description: events.media_state lifecycle, also used as event_state_transitions.from_state/to_state (03_DATA_MODEL_AND_API_CONTRACTS.md 'events'; 02_V1_ARCHITECTURE_SPEC.md 'Event lifecycle').

streamSessionStates.description: stream_sessions.status lifecycle (03_DATA_MODEL_AND_API_CONTRACTS.md 'stream_sessions'). A reconnect creates a new row rather than reopening the old session identity.

mediaJobTypes.description: media_jobs.type — required aggregate job types (03_DATA_MODEL_AND_API_CONTRACTS.md 'media_jobs'). Never one row per HLS segment.

versioning.rule: schemaVersion follows semver against this file's shape and values. A backward-compatible addition (new optional field, new enum value approved by an ADR) increments MINOR. Any rename, removal, or required/optional change increments MAJOR and requires updating the Go and TypeScript representations and their validation tests in the same change. PATCH is reserved for documentation-only edits with no field or value change.
versioning.process: Do not add a new state or field here unless it already exists in an approved architecture document (03_DATA_MODEL_AND_API_CONTRACTS.md, 05_DECISIONS.md) or an applied Supabase migration. Architecture changes are proposed as a new ADR first; this file is updated after approval, not before.
